falsification_conditions.condition: Price closes above the 200-day moving average by 5% or more
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would indicate a strong bullish trend contradicting the 'bottom' pattern and invalidating the HOLD signal.

falsification_conditions.condition: Volume spikes to 3x the 30-day average on a single day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such a surge would suggest a blowoff top or extreme market conviction, directly opposing the current HOLD and unknown verdict.

falsification_conditions.condition: The 14-day Relative Strength Index (RSI) crosses above 70 and stays above for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This overbought condition would signal a potential reversal invalidating the 'bottom' pattern and proving the current call wrong.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
